You’ll be able to pick your card color and activate your virtual card in about 60 seconds. If approved, your virtual card is ready to use right away. Add it to your digital wallet and shop anywhere Visa is accepted.\n\nA paid Klarna membership plan is required if you’d like a physical card. Applying for the Klarna Card won’t affect your credit score. Charges may apply when using pay later plans or enrolling in a paid membership.","tagList":["klarna-card"],"contentType":"faqListItem"},{"id":"2bQhz5Uy3Gmv6CUtdKBL8P","type":"Entry","createdAt":"2025-09-25T17:42:50.274Z","updatedAt":"2025-09-25T17:42:50.274Z","locale":"en-US","internalName":"US - What is OnePay Later, and how does it work? _ OnePay Later","question":"What is OnePay Later, and how does it work?","answer":"Klarna has partnered with OnePay to bring flexible pay over time options to Walmart shoppers through OnePay Later. With OnePay Later, you can shop at Walmart.com, in the Walmart app, or in-store and pay in smaller, fixed, payments. Simply add what you need into your shopping cart, choose OnePay Later at checkout as your payment method, and if approved, choose a payment plan that fits your monthly budget. You’ll receive your full payment schedule, including details of your first due payment, by email once your purchase is processed by Walmart. You can also manage your payments in the [Klarna app](https:\u002F\u002Fwww.klarna.com\u002Fus\u002Fklarna-app\u002F) or [OnePay app](https:\u002F\u002Fone-web.app.link\u002Fdownload).\n\nGood to know:\n\n- The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) for purchases is between 9.99%-35.99%¹\n\n- OnePay Later loans are powered by Klarna and issued by WebBank\n\nClick [here](https:\u002F\u002Fwww.klarna.com\u002Fus\u002Fklarna-onepay\u002F?utm_source=klarna&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=website-klarna-landing-page-gtm) to learn more about OnePay Later.","tagList":["one-pay-later"],"contentType":"faqListItem"},{"id":"7DJkUmTQOxLEIVdQOC9mL3","type":"Entry","createdAt":"2025-09-25T17:44:09.144Z","updatedAt":"2025-09-25T17:44:09.144Z","locale":"en-US","internalName":"US - How do I apply to OnePay Later? _ OnePay Later","question":"How do I apply to OnePay Later?","answer":"Just select OnePay Later when checking out at Walmart.com, in the Walmart app, or in-store. If approved, you will be presented with up to three payment plans. Choose the best plan for you, and then complete your purchase. You may be eligible to pay over time with OnePay Later on purchases between $50 and $6,000.\n","tagList":["one-pay-later"],"contentType":"faqListItem"},{"id":"2972W63mMuvBgNUNyVmJkC","type":"Entry","createdAt":"2025-09-25T17:45:40.273Z","updatedAt":"2025-09-25T17:45:46.523Z","locale":"en-US","internalName":"US - Does OnePay Later have any impacts to my credit score? _ OnePay Later","question":"Does OnePay Later have any impacts to my credit score?","answer":"There are no impacts to your credit score when you apply. Klarna and Bank Partners perform a soft credit check which does not affect your credit score and will not be visible to other lenders. Klarna shares information about loans and your repayment activity with the credit bureaus - TransUnion and Experian, such as if you pay on time, or make late payments or fail to pay. For now, the shared data will not impact your score, as it is only visible to you. Other institutions currently are not able to view the payment history on your loans.","tagList":["one-pay-later"],"contentType":"faqListItem"},{"id":"2NUYZC5xyICw3klU3vVVnU","type":"Entry","createdAt":"2025-09-23T13:54:35.349Z","updatedAt":"2026-07-28T12:50:26.514Z","locale":"en-US","internalName":"US - How do I use Klarna on Apple Pay for in-store purchases?","question":"How do I use Klarna on Apple Pay for in-store purchases?","answer":"If shopping in-store and using Klarna with Apple Pay for the first time, you’ll need to add Klarna to your Apple Wallet:\n\n1. Open Apple Wallet on your iPhone.\n2. Tap the Add (+) button, select Pay Later Options, choose Klarna.\n3. Follow the steps to complete the setup.\n\nWhen you're ready to pay:\n\n1. Double-click the side button of your iPhone and select your Klarna card.\n2. Tap the payment option selector and select Pay Later.\n3. Follow the steps to choose a plan that works best for you.\n4. Hold your iPhone near the reader to complete your purchase.\n\nFor future purchases, you’ll still need to be approved by Klarna.\n","tagList":["apple-pay","not:ba94b586-39bc-4ade-a765-9cae8561779d"],"contentType":"faqListItem"},{"id":"6Y8WnOOPQz8ufrLZDVrUTz","type":"Entry","createdAt":"2025-09-23T13:55:50.578Z","updatedAt":"2026-07-28T12:50:30.020Z","locale":"en-US","internalName":"US-How do I use Klarna on Apple Pay for online purchases?","question":"How do I use Klarna on Apple Pay for online purchases?","answer":"You can use Klarna’s payment options directly on Apple Pay when shopping online or in app, on iPhone or iPad.\n\n1. When checking out, choose Apple Pay, tap ”Other Cards & Pay Later Options”.\n2. Select Klarna then tap Continue to Klarna and follow the verification steps.\n3. Choose your preferred payment plan and confirm the purchase.\n\nA card will be added to Apple Wallet. For future purchases, you’ll still need to be approved by Klarna.\n\n__Good to know:__\n- You’ll receive your order confirmation by email.\n- You can view and manage all your purchases in the Klarna app or on klarna.com.\n- Be sure your device is updated to the latest iOS or iPadOS version.","tagList":["apple-pay","not:ba94b586-39bc-4ade-a765-9cae8561779d"],"contentType":"faqListItem"},{"id":"2UtE4fg4e06Xl7igFjHyJW","type":"Entry","createdAt":"2025-01-22T09:43:41.806Z","updatedAt":"2025-02-20T13:28:00.278Z","locale":"en-US","internalName":"US - How can I use Klarna on Google Pay?","question":"How can I use Klarna on Google Pay?","answer":"You can use Klarna’s payment options directly on Google Pay when shopping online or in apps.\n1. Link your Google Pay account to Klarna and choose your preferred payment plan before you confirm the purchase\n\n__Good to know: __ \n- You’ll receive your order confirmation by email.\n- You can view and manage all your purchases in the Klarna app or on klarna.com.\n- In-store purchases are not supported.","tagList":["google-pay"],"contentType":"faqListItem"},{"id":"r0iFKZ11tN31pvag1kaiD","type":"Entry","createdAt":"2025-01-21T19:26:19.808Z","updatedAt":"2026-07-23T12:39:09.328Z","locale":"en-US","internalName":"US - How much am I eligible to spend?","question":"How much am I eligible to spend?","answer":"There is no predefined spending limit when using Klarna. Instead, a new automated approval decision about how much you can spend with us is made each time you pay with Klarna.\n\n__To see your estimated amount to spend:__\n- [Log in here](https:\u002F\u002Fapp.klarna.com\u002Flogin)\n- Navigate to your profile to see your purchase power\n\nYour Purchase power is an estimated amount based on factors such as your payment history with Klarna and your outstanding balance. The amount is not a guarantee and may change based on the store and payment option you choose.\n\n__I want to increase my purchase power__\nA good payment history, always paying on time and making payments towards your outstanding purchases can increase your purchase power over time. Our Customer Service can’t accept requests for spending limit increases.\n\n__My purchase power is $0__\nIf you’ve spent above your purchase power, then your purchase power will be $0. Making payments towards your outstanding purchases can increase your purchase power.\n\n__My purchase power is not available__\nIf you have overdue or failed payments, then your purchase power will not be available. To increase your chance of approval to shop with Klarna, and view your purchase power, settle your failed or overdue payments.\n\n__Is purchase power and pre-qualification different?__\n- Purchase power may change based on the store and payment option you choose.\n- Prequalification is store-specific and evaluates how much you can spend with different payment options, including Financing. \n- You can make up to 3 prequalification attempts at each store within 48 hours.","tagList":["global","not:ba94b586-39bc-4ade-a765-9cae8561779d"],"contentType":"faqListItem"},{"id":"1GJzSfhk3AMZQWxyh8gHcy","type":"Entry","createdAt":"2024-12-06T08:23:02.215Z","updatedAt":"2026-07-22T16:47:34.283Z","locale":"en-US","internalName":"US - Does Klarna perform a credit check and will this affect my credit score?","question":"Does Klarna perform a credit check and will this affect my credit score?","answer":"Klarna evaluates your ability to pay by assessing available data to ensure responsible lending.\n\nWhen a credit check is performed, we verify your identity using the details you provided and we look at information from your credit report to understand your financial behavior and evaluate your creditworthiness.\n\nWe will __not__ perform a credit check when:\n- Signing up to use Klarna\n- Downloading the [app](https:\u002F\u002Fwww.klarna.com\u002Fus\u002Fklarna-app\u002F)\n\nWe will perform a soft credit check when you:\n- Use [Pay in 4](https:\u002F\u002Fwww.klarna.com\u002Fus\u002Fpay-in-4\u002F)\n- Use [Pay in 30 days](https:\u002F\u002Fwww.klarna.com\u002Fus\u002Flegal\u002F)\n- Use [Monthly financing](https:\u002F\u002Fwww.klarna.com\u002Fus\u002Flegal\u002F)\n- Apply for a [Klarna Card](https:\u002F\u002Fwww.klarna.com\u002Fus\u002Fklarna-card\u002F)\n\nSoft credit checks do not affect your credit score and will not be visible to other lenders.\n\n__Good to know:__\n- If you make late payments or fail to pay, this could have a negative impact on your creditworthiness and prevent you from using our payment methods. Read more about [how these credit checks impact your credit score](https:\u002F\u002Fwww.klarna.com\u002Fus\u002Fcustomer-service\u002Fdoes-klarna-affect-my-credit-score\u002F).\n- Using the prequalification feature will not affect your credit score in any way, whatever the outcome.\n\nOur third party credit checks are performed by [Transunion](https:\u002F\u002Fwww.transunion.com\u002F). If you have questions regarding their services, your credit score, or the data provided as part of a credit check we advise you to reach out to them directly.\n\nThese checks are performed in accordance with [Klarna’s Terms & Conditions](https:\u002F\u002Fwww.klarna.com\u002Fus\u002Flegal\u002F).","tagList":["global","not:ba94b586-39bc-4ade-a765-9cae8561779d"],"contentType":"faqListItem"},{"id":"3J939BE5tVB6uujL6N95Tx","type":"Entry","createdAt":"2025-10-02T12:46:53.586Z","updatedAt":"2025-10-03T17:32:18.466Z","locale":"en-US","internalName":"US IE - What are the benefits or rewards of using the Klarna app?
